application_integrity_scope: Existing ninety-file source publication is not rewritten or re-read; its manifest and sealed integrity evidence are retained
report_policy: JSON/MD reports are derived path-redacted copies; raw and published hashes are separate
path_policy: Owned report roots become portable references relative to this suite; other local roots use [LOCAL_ROOT]
seal_policy: Seal hashes refer to original raw reports; compare with raw_sha256, not redacted report bytes
verification_policy: All eight reviewed verifier/protocol files are byte-identical, including their original fixed-path assumptions

privacy_scan.limitations: Targeted signature/name scan and fixed allowlist; not a guarantee against every sensitive format
